entities.name: Ákos Hadházy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ákos Ányos Hadházy is a Hungarian veterinarian, politician and anti-corruption activist. He was co-president of the Politics Can Be Different party from 2016 to 2018, and has been a member of the National Assembly (MP) from the party's National List since 2016, and an independent representative for Budapest 8th Constituency since 2022.

entities.summary: Ákos Ányos Hadházy is a Hungarian veterinarian, politician and anti-corruption activist. He was co-president of the Politics Can Be Different party from 2016 to 2018, and has been a member of the National Assembly (MP) from the party's National List since 2016, and an independent representative for Budapest 8th Constituency since 2022.
